ff_guard_1.m: Ha ha, you tell him Garl! *burp*

ff_guard_2.m: Sing, drink, fight! All who oppose Feygard will fall!

ff_guard_3.m: We will stand tall. Feygard, city of peace!
r: Have you seen a boy called Rincel around here recently?

ff_guard_4.m: What, you haven't heard of Feygard, kid? Just follow the road northwest and you will see the great city of Feygard rise above the treetops.

ff_guard_rincel_1.m: A boy?! Apart from you, there have been no children in here that I have seen.

ff_guard_rincel_2.m: Check with the captain over there. He has been around here for longer than us.
r: Thank you. Shadow be with you.

ff_guard_shadow_1.m: Don't bring that cursed Shadow in here son. We want none of that. Now leave.

wrye.10: Jolnor in Vilegard chapel wants me to talk to Wrye in northern Vilegard. She has apparently lost her son recently.
wrye.20: Wrye in northern Vilegard tells me that her son Rincel has gone missing. She thinks that he has died or gotten critically hurt.
wrye.30: Wrye tells me that she thinks the royal guard from Feygard are involved in his disappearance, and that they have recruited him.
wrye.40: Wrye wants me to go search for clues as to what has happened to her son.
wrye.41: I should go look in the Vilegard tavern and the Foaming Flask tavern north of Vilegard.
wrye.42: I heard of a boy being in the Foaming Flask tavern a while ago. Apparently he left to the west of the tavern somewhere.
wrye.80: To the northwest of Vilegard I found a man that had found Rincel fighting some monsters. Rincel had apparently left Vilegard by his own will to go see the city of Feygard. I should go tell Wrye in northern Vilegard what happened to her son.
wrye.90: I have told Wrye the truth about her son's disappearance.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
